stem:
Chirag has a small electric cell. One end has a raised metal cap. The other end is a flat metal disc.

Which claim about the cell is correct?

options.text: The raised metal cap is the positive terminal and the flat metal disc is the negative terminal.
The flat metal disc is the positive terminal and the raised metal cap is the negative terminal.
Either end of the cell can be treated as the positive terminal.
Both ends of the cell are negative terminals.

teacher.key_rationale: The raised metal cap is the positive terminal and the flat metal disc is the negative terminal.
